watchSessions.review: He said that she prefers bread to his dad, but in the end, when she realized he was gone, she dropped her bread and desperately looked for him ´;︵;`

First of all, if you have never been lonely, really lonely, you will find this movie very boring. For me, it wasn't boring at all, and it made me feel weird because I could resonate with her a lot.

Maybe the main character was 'introverted' way before her mother's death, but the death of a beloved definitely made her way more lonely and careless towards life than before. She doesn't want to communicate with anyone, including herself, so she always puts a video or TV show to be busy with. She sleeps with the TV open, wakes up, and the TV is still open; on the bus, still watching something, etc.

After she was forced to teach a newbie about the job, even if she didn't realize it, she bonded with the newbie. After the newbie is gone, she gets a panic attack because she once again lost someone. Even when she was eating, she couldn't eat like before, probably because she wasn't actually enjoying eating alone and realized this at that moment. She actually confesses that she doesn't want to be alone but puts up an 'okay' face.

After all, I think it was a well-portrayed movie. The ending made me think a lot. It's a good watch if you enjoy slow-paced movies or can resonate with the main character.
